plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Deaf Studies A.A. Degree - Local GE' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 24, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7914/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: CRC Local GE. Map states Total Units 60-63; lower bound 60 used = 14+19+14+13 (semester sums verified at lower bounds: Sem 1 Area L2 3-4 -> 3; Sem 3 Elective 1-3 -> 1). Semester 4 restricted choice: DEAF 311 requires DEAF 310; DEAF 354 and DEAF 380 require DEAF 314 (per map) — all are sequenced earlier in this plan. Elective units are determined by the number needed to total 60 units for graduation.
